description: This Java class implements the Exponential Distribution as part of the Apache Commons Math library, providing methods for density, cumulative probability, inverse cumulative, sampling, and distribution parameters.

classes.name: ExponentialDistribution
classes.description: Implements the exponential distribution with methods for density, cumulative probability, inverse, and sampling.

methods.name: getMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution.

methods.name: density
methods.description: Calculates the probability density function at a given point.

methods.name: logDensity
methods.description: Calculates the log of the density at a given point.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Computes the cumulative distribution function at a specified value.

methods.name: inverseCumulativeProbability
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of the cumulative distribution function for a given probability.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates a random sample from the distribution.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the mean (expected value) of the distribution.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the support (always 0).

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the support (positive infinity).

methods.name: isSupportLowerBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates whether the lower support bound is inclusive (true).

methods.name: isSupportUpperBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates whether the upper support bound is inclusive (false).

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Indicates whether the support is connected (true).
